reference: Sentinel-1 (ESA, C band) · OPERA RTC-S1 via NASA GIBS
method: 1 km hexagons of polygons.geojson; S1 clearing = baseline forest (bright VH) whose VH median dropped more than 99 % of the stable forest and ended open, patches >= 5 ha; a hexagon matches when S1 marks >= 25 % of the NISAR hectares (>= 2 ha). Chance level: the same hexagons shifted 5-7 km onto areas without clearing.
